title: Obstructions for codimension one multiple fibers of Lagrangian and Calabi--Yau fibrations
summary: We prove that compact hyper-Kähler manifolds with a Lagrangian fibration over a projective space have no multiple fibers in codimension one. This has several consequences for the structure of Lagrangian fibrations, including progress on Sawon's conjecture on general singular fibers, Kamenova--Lu anti-hyperbolicity, and the extension of the Néron model action to a big open subset of the base.
